# Was Kurly hacked in the Nov 2026 data breach?

**Reported.** Reported. Kurly itself says an outside attacker stole login credentials and used them to reach internal systems on Nov 17, and that about 10,900 people's data leaked. No outside party has checked this or named the attacker.

Incident: Was Kurly hacked? Curator and employee data breach, Nov 2026. Also reported as Kurly data leak and Market Kurly personal information leak. First published Nov 23, 2026; last updated Nov 23, 2026, 12:15 PM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Kurly, any news outlet, regulator, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 23, 2026, 12:15 PM ET: **Kurly says an outside attacker used stolen logins to reach its systems and about 10,900 people's data leaked; attacker Not established.** New incident page. Sources read: Kurly's apology notice (full text as reprinted by one outlet), Yonhap, Hankyung, Chosunbiz, EBN, SBS, KBS and Sports Donga, all repeating Kurly's own statements, counted as one source. The breach, victim counts and data types are Reported, not Confirmed, because we did not read the notice on Kurly's site. Attacker and method: Not established. No privacy-regulator or KISA statement found. Curators are social media promoters, not delivery staff. Four customers were affected, not two. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details. We opened no leak or dark-web sites.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Regional. About 10,900 people, by Kurly's own counts: 10,699 curators, 199 current and former employees and 4 customers. Some curators' bank and ID numbers were included. Revisit if Kurly or a regulator gives new numbers.
- Who is affected: Kurly's 'curators' (people who promote Kurly products on social media for a fee), 199 current and former employees, and 4 ordinary customers. Kurly says it is notifying them. Be wary of calls, texts or emails asking for bank or ID details.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 10,699 | Curators whose data leaked | Kurly's count, Nov 20 |
| 199 | Current and former employees | Added by Kurly on Nov 23 |
| 4 | Ordinary customers | 2 on Nov 20, 2 more on Nov 23 |

### Known so far

- Nothing is established yet.

### Not known yet

- Who the attacker was and how the login credentials were stolen.
- How many curators had bank or ID numbers exposed, and whether those were encrypted.
- Whether the stolen data has been published or misused.
- Whether the privacy regulator has opened an investigation.
